title: PushFile
description: push.json (data folder root): the board's VAPID keys and the devices that turned phone push on. Type PushFile in src/helper/push.ts (PushDevice extends PushTarget from src/helper/webpush.ts). Written by PushService.write (pretty JSON, 2-space indent, final newline, fixed push.json.tmp then rename, mode 0600 when the tmp is new); a missing or keyless file gets fresh VAPID keys on first read. Holds secrets: vapid.privateKey and each device's push keys. Note: PushService.read rebuilds the object from vapid, devices and dropped, so other top-level keys are lost on the next write today. Unknown fields inside devices must be kept.

publicKey.description: Uncompressed P-256 public key, base64url without padding.

privateKey.description: P-256 private key, base64url without padding. Secret.

dropped.description: Devices the board removed because their push service said they are gone (404/410), newest last. Missing until the first drop.

label.description: e.g. "iPhone · Safari (Home Screen)"; at most 80 chars; default "Browser".

thisMac.description: Turned on in a browser on this Mac. Written only as true.
